description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Nocturne''' casts out a shadow blade in the target direction that leaves a ''Dusk Trail'' in its wake, dealing physical damage to enemies hit. Enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] and large [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] hit will leave a ''Dusk Trail'' behind while moving. ''Dusk Trails'' last 5 seconds and will slowly disappear afterwards.

notes.raw: * ''Duskbringer'' checks for and hits targets 25 units outside of the missile's maximum range. * ''Duskbringer's'' damage is not increased by the '''bonus''' AD gained from its trail, meaning that casting it again while on the trail from the last cast will not result in higher damage. ** It is observed from seasons ago that this is intentionally hard-coded into the ability to avoid the projectile increasing its own damage. This feature is somewhat deprecated as it also limits chain-casting ''Duskbringer''. * ''Duskbringer's Dusk Trail'' will expose the path of affected units until its duration ends. It is a form of [[File:Sweeper Drone icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Obscured vision|An icon representing the keyword Obscured vision]] [[:Sight#Obscured vision|obscured vision]]; the trail indirectly reveals the location of enemy units even in the fog of war, including those shrouded by [[File:Guerrilla Warfare.png|20px|link=Stealth|An icon representing the keyword Stealth]] [[:Stealth|stealth]]. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will block the damage and also prevents the ''Dusk Trail'' from following the target. * The formed ''Dusk Trail'' does not disappear if ''Duskbringer'' is intercepted by [[File:Yasuo Wind Wall.png|20xpx|border|link=Yasuo#Wind Wall|An icon for Yasuo's ability Wind Wall]] [[Yasuo#Wind Wall|Wind Wall]] or [[File:Braum Unbreakable.png|20xpx|border|link=Braum#Unbreakable|An icon for Braum's ability Unbreakable]] [[Braum#Unbreakable|Unbreakable]]. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time. * The '''bonus''' movement speed [[File:Multiple stacking icon.png|20px|link=Stacking#Stacks_multiplicatively|An icon representing the keyword Stacks multiplicatively]] [[:Stacking#Stacks_multiplicatively|stacks multiplicatively]] with other sources of movement speed boosts.
notes.text:
Duskbringer checks for and hits targets 25 units outside of the missile's maximum range.
Duskbringer's damage is not increased by the bonus AD gained from its trail, meaning that casting it again while on the trail from the last cast will not result in higher damage.
* It is observed from seasons ago that this is intentionally hard-coded into the ability to avoid the projectile increasing its own damage. This feature is somewhat deprecated as it also limits chain-casting Duskbringer.
Duskbringer's Dusk Trail will expose the path of affected units until its duration ends. It is a form of obscured vision; the trail indirectly reveals the location of enemy units even in the fog of war, including those shrouded by stealth.
Spell shield will block the damage and also prevents the Dusk Trail from following the target.
The formed Dusk Trail does not disappear if Duskbringer is intercepted by Wind Wall or Unbreakable.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
The bonus movement speed stacks multiplicatively with other sources of movement speed boosts.
